name: Petty Bot
tagline: Keeps score on your follower list and returns every quiet unfollow
description: It tracks the shape of your connections on X over time. When an account that recently linked up with you drops the follow a short while later, the bot notices and mirrors the move on your behalf, so your following list stays reciprocal without you auditing it by hand. Petty entirely by design.
author: zachery
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
